content: Reorganized the web app structure by clarifying the roles of app, components, hooks, and lib, consolidating scattered types and content utilities, and removing obsolete files and ignore-list noise
Unified article authoring extensions with reusable components such as WebsiteCard, centralized embed rendering, and a practical writing guide under content/posts
Added an interactive travel-route component backed by JSON, with map exploration, Stop details, first-view playback, and an initial embed in the Wuhan food walk post
Improved initial loading by trimming font subsets, loading the About font and math styles on demand, generating lighter responsive images, and reducing below-the-fold preloading
Simplified the homepage radar and games-page hierarchy while aligning dark cards, map popups, radar coordinates, and related interface details
Fixed the homepage blog rail mouse interaction so cards can still open posts while drag-to-scroll remains available
Refined the article TOC sidebar by hiding the top-level article title, expanding the active section title, and letting the highlight bar follow the expanded height
Updated the rich-mode blog category dropdown with a tighter two-column layout, post counts, active-category highlighting, and better narrow-screen behavior
Added rich-mode archive tag filtering with shared-tag hover highlights, click-to-combine filters, one-click clearing, and stronger hover visibility
Unified the card color treatment across archive, links, and timeline hint panels, and documented the design patterns for future UI work
Optimized first-screen performance by reducing initial loading and rendering overhead for a smoother entry experience
Added a vertical scrolling image showcase to enrich image browsing
Fixed several UI display and layout issues across blog filters, the navbar, the blog list, and the games page for steadier visual hierarchy
Reworked the theme curtain transition: with target-theme symbols, dark-mode stars, and a longer page color transition to reduce glare during day/night switches
Reworked the games page presentation: Most Played now uses an auto-scrolling rail, while All Games uses a Steam-style vertical-cover showcase with interactions
Unified the card treatment across games, movies, blog, and links pages by softening outer borders and relying on backgrounds, shadows, and spacing for hierarchy
Removed outer border lines from the navbar and dropdown surfaces while keeping necessary internal dividers and keyboard focus feedback
Added a curtain-style theme transition: the current theme drops down, the theme switches while covered, and the curtain pulls back up with a smoother motion curve

Tuned Cloudflare Image Transformations for blog and life images: article covers now reuse a lighter 1200px profile, cards and thumbnails use smaller variants, and all optimized images fall back to originals with onerror=redirect when the free transformation quota is exceeded
Added a compact movie-page guestbook powered by Twikoo
Refined the guestbook composer: comments stay visible by default
Polished the homepage title rotation with a width-aware animated color chip
Improved blog category presentation: added the Share category entry, paired each category with its icon, and switched category badges to lightweight colored icon-and-text labels
Refined the blog category dropdown: removed selected checkmarks and internal category colors, enlarged menu items, and let the drawer width fit the longest label naturally
Unified the metadata scale and spacing on blog cards so category, date, and word count share a cleaner visual hierarchy
Applied the same content-fit dropdown width behavior to the navbar's other-entry menu, removing extra right-side whitespace
Refined blog article heading hierarchy: added numbered h2 styling with a theme-color underline glow, restored the small accent marker for h3, and unified heading rendering across posts
Improved in-article link previews: fixed hover preview and hover animation issues in Mac Chrome, and repositioned the preview card so it no longer blocks link clicks

Optimized homepage mobile scrolling performance: layout measurements dropped by about 63%, style calculations dropped by about 66%, mobile scroll sampling holds p95 around 16.8ms, and no long tasks were observed
Updated the type system: English headings now use Montserrat, while Chinese text uses Alibaba PuHuiTi
Reworked the homepage blog showcase: removed scroll-progress coupling and per-frame measurements, switched to a passive auto-scrolling rail, and added a scroll-speed control
Adjusted the homepage opening rhythm: the hero and blog showcase now snap as 100vh sections, while scrolling returns to normal for the longer sections after the third screen
Added vertical cut-reveal motion to the homepage hero title and copy, with refined text hierarchy and opacity
Fixed the third-screen travel widget sequence: the heading stays visible while the LED footprint map, life clock, and interactive map appear in order
Enhanced code block styling for better readability
Optimized comment loading logic to reduce user wait time
Added font opacity levels to enhance hierarchy and highlight key information
Fixed the sticky logic of blog overview page widgets to ensure correct display during scrolling
Enhanced the design of our cc copyright page
Improved the styling of our blog pagination component
Enhanced the TOC sidebar
Fixed movie page display logic
Adjusted dark mode colors for a more comfortable reading experience (previously too cold and unappealing)
Added homepage cover image for blog page, optimized motto display, and enriched page content.
Polished RSS feeds view with back-to-home and bilingual toggle
Enabled article TOC visibility on mobile
Added scroll-to-top progress button
Updated timeline logic
Added blog homepage cover image and surfaced it in the overview list
Simplified blog overview cards by reorganizing the information layout
